value: Bangs are shortcuts that allow users to directly search specific external websites by prepending a unique site-specific `!` command (e.g., `!w` for Wikipedia) to their query, significantly expediting access to desired results. However, it is crucial to note that searches conducted via bangs occur on the external site, making users subject to that site's own policies, including its data collection practices. Introduced in 2008, thousands of bangs are now available, with users also able to submit their own.
